desc_CN: 1.修复麦克风使用时延迟问题
2.修复 2.4G 模式通话时有概率断连的问题
3.修复 2.4G 模式播放音乐，插入声卡线音乐无声问题
4.修复 2.4G 模式回连时，左耳底噪杂音的问题

6.修复部分已知问题
desc_EN: 1.Fixed latency issue when using the microphone
2.Fixed occasional disconnection during calls in 2.4G mode
3.Fixed an issue where no music audio plays when inserting the sound card cable while playing music in 2.4G mode
4.Fixed background noise on the left earbud during reconnection in 2.4G mode
5.Fixed an issue with no downlink audio when switching PC output devices while monitor mode is enabled under 2.4G mode
6.Fixed some known issues
